title: Three-joint arm
about: A planar arm: a base and three links, each 50 mm long with a hole at each end, 40 mm apart. Each link turns on the one before on a revolute joint whose sides are the holes' rims, so each sits on top of the last, 4 mm higher.
commands: run --save Base.sb feature.add_box size=30,30,10 corner=-15,-15,0 name=Block
run --open Base.sb --save Base.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=10 name=PivotHole
run --open Base.sb --save Base.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Block b=PivotHole name=Base
run --save Link.sb feature.add_box size=50,10,4 corner=0,-5,0 name=Bar
run --open Link.sb --save Link.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=4 base=5,0,0 name=NearHole
run --open Link.sb --save Link.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=4 base=45,0,0 name=FarHole
run --open Link.sb --save Link.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Bar b=NearHole name=Near
run --open Link.sb --save Link.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Near b=FarHole name=Link
run --open Arm.sb --save Arm.sb component.insert file=Link.sb count=3 at=0,40,0 step=0,20,0
run --open Arm.sb --save Arm.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Base 1:edge:13" "b=Link 1:edge:3" name=Shoulder value=30
run --open Arm.sb --save Arm.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Link 1:edge:16" "b=Link 2:edge:3" name=Elbow value=45
run --open Arm.sb --save Arm.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Link 2:edge:16" "b=Link 3:edge:3" name=Wrist value=-60

change.command: run --open Arm.sb --save Arm.sb joint.set joint=Elbow value=-90
change.about: bend the elbow back 90 degrees: the second and third links swing round the elbow, and the third keeps its angle to the second.
